svg.title: Config hot reload
svg.desc: Three triggers, SIGUSR1, the config file watch and a reloadable PATCH, deliver a freshly loaded config to ConfigNotifier.reload. It primes out-of-package parsers, refuses a config with blocking warnings or unsupported container isolation, compares every section, carries server.port, host, data_dir and container forward, and returns a ConfigDelta for reloadable sections only. A restart-tier change goes to restartRequiredSections and is withheld. Reconfigurable services run when their watch keys changed.

g.text: Hover a box for what it does; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Reloadable: server, sessions, context, security, logging, workspace, alerts. Every other section is restart-tier.

svg.text: A bad config is refused whole; a restart-tier change is logged and withheld; only reloadable sections reach services.

g.class: e join f-sig f-watch f-apply t-n1
e main f-sig f-watch f-apply t-n1

g.text: SIGUSR1 · registered whenever POSIX signals are available and the mode is not off
In signal mode on Windows the service only logs that signal reload is POSIX-only.
config file watch · watches the parent directory, not the file: an atomic temp+rename save is create or modify on macOS but a move on Linux
A watch failure falls back to SIGUSR1 only, or to no reload on Windows. Any exception in a cycle logs and keeps the existing config.
ConfigApplyService · calls notifier.reload(loadDartclawConfig(file)) directly, without ReloadTriggerService
A throw falls back to restart-pending for those fields.
prime section parsers · sectionPrimers run the parsers of packages outside the kernel, so their warnings are present before admission
The primers come from the harness registrars (primeConfigSections); the same priming runs in the CLI loader.
admit or refuse · FormatException on blocking warnings; UnsupportedCapabilityError if isolation is enabled where unsupported
A refused reload leaves the running config and restartRequiredSections untouched.
compare every section · a changed reloadable section adds <section>.* to changedKeys; a restart section goes to the restart set
server is special: a change confined to port, host, data_dir is excluded with a warning. Tier keys are DartclawConfig field names, not YAML keys.
carry forward · a reload must not change these running values
container is carried forward because a startup probe settled the posture and an unset section re-parses as disabled.
build the delta · returns null when nothing reloadable changed, else ConfigDelta(previous, current, changedKeys)
It then calls reconfigure on each registered service whose watchKeys match, logging and continuing if one throws.
reload refused · nothing changes and restartRequiredSections is left as it was
ReloadTriggerService logs the refusal and keeps the running config; doctor reports blocking warnings as failures.
restartRequiredSections · the change is persisted but takes effect only after a restart
ReloadTriggerService logs the section names. restart.pending is the durable record, not this set.
ConfigDelta · changedKeys holds one <section>.* entry per changed reloadable section
ConfigDelta.hasChanged matches by prefix in both directions: watch key context.reserve_tokens matches changed key context.*.
called when delta.hasChangedAny(watchKeys); a throw is logged and the rest still run
nine services: security, logging, sessions, server, context, workspace, alerts
Reconfigurable services · Reconfigurable is a watchKeys set plus a synchronous reconfigure(ConfigDelta) that must not throw
register() throws ArgumentError for a watch key naming a restart-tier or undeclared section, so no watcher is ever dead.
